name: Bench Press
description: Classic horizontal barbell press. Lie flat on a bench, lower the bar to mid-chest, press back up. Primary chest builder.

name: Incline Bench Press
description: Barbell or dumbbell press on a 30-45° incline. Emphasises the upper portion of the pectorals.

name: Decline Bench Press
description: Press performed on a downward-angled bench. Targets the lower chest and allows heavier loads than flat pressing.

name: Dumbbell Flye
description: Lying dumbbell fly with a slight elbow bend. Stretches and contracts the pectorals through a wide arc.

name: Cable Crossover
description: High-to-low or level cable fly. Provides constant tension across the full range of motion.

name: Push-Up
description: Bodyweight pressing movement. Engages chest, anterior delts, and triceps. Scalable via elevation or resistance bands.

name: Chest Dip
description: Parallel-bar dip with a slight forward lean to maximise pectoral stretch and activation.

name: Pec Deck
description: Machine fly that isolates the pectorals without requiring stabilisation. Good for mind-muscle connection work.

name: Deadlift
description: Barbell pull from the floor. Full posterior-chain movement — lats, spinal erectors, glutes, hamstrings. Foundation of strength training.

name: Pull-Up
description: Overhand-grip bodyweight vertical pull. Targets lats, rhomboids, and biceps. Add weight via belt for progression.

name: Barbell Row
description: Bent-over barbell row with overhand or underhand grip. Builds thickness in the mid and upper back.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Cable pulldown to the upper chest. Develops lat width. Use a wide or neutral grip for different emphases.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: Horizontal cable row from a seated position. Targets the mid-back, rhomboids, and rear delts.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: Unilateral row braced against a bench. Allows a longer range of motion and corrects side-to-side imbalances.

name: Face Pull
description: Cable pull to the face with rope attachment. Primarily targets rear delts and external rotators. Shoulder health essential.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Landmine or dedicated T-bar row. Allows heavy loading with a neutral spine. Great for back thickness.

name: Squat
description: Barbell back squat — the king of lower-body exercises. Trains quads, glutes, and entire posterior chain under heavy load.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip-hinge movement keeping the bar close to the legs. Primary hamstring and glute stretch-under-load exercise.

name: Leg Press
description: Machine-based quad-dominant press. Allows heavy loading without spinal compression. Foot position shifts emphasis.

name: Leg Curl
description: Lying or seated machine curl that isolates the hamstrings. Key accessory for knee health and hamstring development.

name: Leg Extension
description: Quad isolation via machine knee extension. Useful for VMO development and rehabilitation work.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Plantarflexion against load. Targets the gastrocnemius. Full stretch at the bottom is essential for hypertrophy.

name: Lunge
description: Unilateral step movement targeting quads and glutes. Walking, reverse, or static variations each have different demands.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: Rear-foot-elevated split squat. High quad and glute demand. Exposes and corrects limb asymmetries.

name: Hack Squat
description: Machine or barbell squat variation with an upright torso. Shifts load further onto the quads.

name: Overhead Press
description: Standing barbell press overhead. Primary shoulder mass builder. Also loads the upper chest and triceps.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Seated or standing dumbbell press. Allows greater range of motion than the barbell version and corrects imbalances.

name: Lateral Raise
description: Dumbbell or cable raise to shoulder height. Targets the medial deltoid — essential for shoulder width.

name: Front Raise
description: Dumbbell raise to the front. Targets the anterior deltoid. Often deprioritised since pressing movements cover front delts well.

name: Rear Delt Fly
description: Bent-over or machine fly targeting the posterior deltoid. Critical for shoulder balance and posture.

name: Arnold Press
description: Dumbbell press with a rotational component through the full range. Hits anterior and medial delts through a longer arc.

name: Upright Row
description: Barbell or cable pull to the chin with elbows flared. Trains medial delts and upper traps together.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: Single-arm lateral raise using a low cable pulley. Maintains tension at the bottom of the movement unlike dumbbells.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Standing supinated curl with a barbell. Primary biceps mass exercise. Allows the heaviest loading of any curl variation.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Neutral-grip dumbbell curl. Targets the brachialis and brachioradialis alongside the biceps. Adds arm thickness.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Curl performed on an incline bench with arms hanging behind the torso. Maximises the long head stretch of the biceps.

name: Preacher Curl
description: Curl with the upper arm braced on a preacher pad. Eliminates cheat and emphasises the peak contraction.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Cable pushdown with rope or bar attachment. Isolates the triceps through elbow extension. High rep finishing move.

name: Skull Crusher
description: Lying EZ-bar or dumbbell extension lowering toward the forehead. Effective for tricep mass — especially the long head.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Bench press with a shoulder-width grip. Allows heavy tricep loading. Overlaps with chest but tricep emphasis is primary.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
description: Dumbbell or cable extension with arms overhead. Stretches the long head of the triceps — best for overall tricep mass.

name: Tricep Dip
description: Parallel-bar dip performed upright. Heavy bodyweight or weighted tricep exercise with carryover to pressing strength.

name: Plank
description: Isometric hold with a straight body from head to heels. Builds anti-extension core stability. Foundation movement.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: Rolling the ab wheel forward from a kneeling position. High demand on the rectus abdominis and anti-extension capability.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Leg raise from a dead hang. Targets the lower abs and hip flexors. Keep the pelvis posteriorly tilted at the top.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Kneeling crunch using a cable overhead. Allows progressive overload on the rectus abdominis unlike bodyweight crunches.

name: Russian Twist
description: Seated rotation holding a weight. Trains the obliques. Add a plate or medicine ball for progressive resistance.

name: Crunch
description: Basic spinal flexion from the floor. Targets upper rectus abdominis. High reps or add a plate for resistance.

name: Dead Bug
description: Supine alternating arm-leg extension. Trains core stability and anti-extension without spinal loading. Rehab-friendly.

name: Pallof Press
description: Anti-rotation cable press. Resists rotational force, training the obliques isometrically. Underrated core stability exercise.
